answer: Pay for heterogeneity in the miner pool. Each epoch, emission weights answers by provenance: rare model families earn a bonus, saturated ones base, and the curve peaks at the vertex of maximum mix. What counts is a canyon of architectural distance between families — a hundred keys running the same weights are still one family. A gale of new vendors widens the bonus budget automatically. A one-model fleet earns base at best, however many keys it runs, while stacking bonuses requires genuinely different engines — scarce, distinct, costly to imitate. Diversity becomes the pay table, not a slogan.
